name: Glorified Bodies
overview: Scripture teaches that our present physical bodies are temporary and subject to mortality, but believers look forward to a transformation where their 'vile bodies' will be changed to be like Christ's glorious body, empowered by His divine ability to subdue all things (Philippians 3:20-21). Jesus Himself demonstrated the reality of a resurrected, glorified body by showing His hands and feet, emphasizing that a spirit does not possess flesh and bones as He did (Luke 24:39). This future hope encourages believers to fear God rather than those who can only harm the body but not the soul, recognizing the eternal significance of the soul and body together (Matthew 10:28).
